name: @w6w-apps/trustpilot
description: Read a Trustpilot Business Unit's profile, reviews and product-review scores, and send review invitations.

w6w.longDescription:
Trustpilot is a customer-review platform organised around the Business Unit — the profile that hosts one website's ratings, reviews and responses. This app covers the two surfaces that are reachable with a straightforward, unattended credential: the Business Units API (company profile, categories, web links, and both the paginated and the cursor-paginated review feeds) and the Product Reviews API (per-SKU review summaries and lists), both of which need nothing but Trustpilot's own API key on every request. It also covers the Invitations API — sending a service or product review invitation by email — which needs a real OAuth access token; this app mints and renews that token itself from a Client ID and Client Secret via the client-credentials grant, so no browser sign-in is required.

Two hosts are in play: `api.trustpilot.com` for everything above, and `invitations-api.trustpilot.com` for the Invitations API specifically — mixing them up is the single most common way a Trustpilot integration breaks. A live status check tracks Trustpilot's own Atlassian Statuspage; Trustpilot publishes no rate-limit response headers, so quota headroom is a declared absence rather than a guess.
